comment: A third country to the common system of VAT of Directive 2006/112/EC,
article 5(2), which applies only in the territory of the Community as the
Treaties define it. Zambia levies its own value added tax under the Value
Added Tax Act, Chapter 331 of the Laws of Zambia, unrelated to the Union's
common system. `vat_prefix` is null: a Zambian taxpayer is identified by
the Taxpayer Identification Number (TPIN) the Zambia Revenue Authority
assigns, which carries no ISO country prefix.
territories.name: Zambia
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and Zambia is a third country to it. Zambia levies a value added tax of its own under the Value Added Tax Act, Chapter 331 of the Laws of Zambia, section 8, at a standard rate of sixteen per cent (16 %), with a rate of zero per cent (0 %) on exports and the supplies the Value Added Tax (Zero-Rating) Order lists.
